title: Palestinian Aggregators and Feeder News Accounts on X
question: Which high-volume X accounts supply footage, casualty frames, and BREAKING cards that influencer accounts later caption - and which are media brands vs anonymous clip warehouses?
scope: X public posts; T0 last 14 days (2026-08-12..26); T1 first-month template formation 2023-10-07..11-07; recycled-media checks unbounded. Languages EN/AR.
publicInterestBasis: This layer is the supply pipe for groups 01-03 influencers; mapping provenance (brand vs anonymous warehouse vs Gaza journalist) bears on assessing claim provenance upstream.
confidence: **Confidence: high on the two-pipelines structure; high on typology; medium on archive-project classification.**

bottomLine.text: **The brief's core assumption is disconfirmed for the current window.** A four-phrase supply-chain audit (distinctive strings from cases 01–03) found **zero precedence by any roster feeder**: the Gulag Ukraine-riot clip exists only as Gulag's own original; the TPUSA-manager story broke via Stew Peters; Shields' "goyim" line circulated since **April 2025** (16 months pre-reuse); and Sulaiman's Gharibabadi item was preceded by **@clashreport** (878K followers — a geopolitics wire not on any roster). **Two separate pipelines exist:** a Gaza/West-Bank documentation pipeline (this roster) and an Iran-war wire pipeline (clashreport/IRIB-family → groups 01/03).

**Typology spectrum verified across nine feeds:** named-source journalism (QudsNen "(QNN)" attributions; EI staff lines @AbubakerAbedW/@JonElmer; AP credits at OnlinePalEng), red-dot BREAKING brand (Timesofgaza, martyr framing + fundraiser RTs), bilingual awareness brand (Eye on Palestine posts AR+EN twins — Arabic twins get ~10–20% of English engagement), anonymous archive collective (`@xIsraelExposedx`), and two protected categories: **on-scene Gaza journalist** (@AbujomaaGaza, self-sourced minutes-old casualty items) and **document-based analyst** (@ytirawi: names IDF Lt.-Col radio transcripts, archival threads).

**`@xIsraelExposedx` reclassified:** not an influencer clip-farm but an **evidence-preservation project** — 146,864 files aggregating *from* Quds News/Evidence Task/martyred journalists (Anas Al-Sharif credited); torrent-seeding model; self-declared ICC/Hind-Rajab-Foundation/ICJ submissions; covered neutrally by Times of Israel (350GB database). Operator remains anonymous; legal-submission claims unverified independently.

**Style notes:** QudsNen runs English-only despite Arabic roots; ToG's "Children of Gaza." minimal-caption format hit 161K views; EoP's Instagram-first identity (13M IG vs 371K X) shows platform asymmetry.

limitations: Mirror harvests (two agents, 15/10-post samples ×8 handles) + API entity resolution + four-phrase earliest-instance audit. Convenience samples; relative timestamps; recycled-media checks limited to text-level (no frame reverse-search this run); about-pages of legacy outlets not fetched (bios used instead). Right-of-reply outstanding. Validator: OK.
unknowns: Operator identities behind QudsNen/ToG/EoP/xIsraelExposedx collectives; T1 template formation depth; Arabic-twin engagement gap causes; full watermark catalog (archive sources page partially documents it).
contradictions: **Protected categories respected:** AbujomaaGaza (Gaza-based, donation-supported field reporting) and ytirawi (analyst) are categorically different from anon aggregation; no smear applied.
OnlinePalEng's Mariam Dagga anniversary item correctly dated and AP-credited (good-practice exhibit).
xIsraelExposedx's own framing ("largest information war… hidden from you", 549K w/ Harrison Smith tag) shows activist register alongside archival function.
T1 template-month (Oct→Nov 2023) under-sampled this run — flagged in events as gap.
